title: Tenet Ferrox
extract:
The Tenet Ferrox is the Tenet variant of the  Ferrox, with improvements to its critical chance, critical multiplier, status chance, fire rate, and magazine size, slightly larger explosion radius, has innate Punch Through , and max radial damage falloff. It's primary fire trigger can be held to continuously charge and fire consecutive shots, essentially functioning like a slow fire rate fully automatic heavy rifle.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage on its primary fire and  Impact damage on its alt-fire.
Primary Fire charges and shoots thin beams.
Holding the fire button after shooting will immediately charge up the next shot.
After reloading, trigger must be released and pressed again to begin firing, however.
Beams are hitscan and do not have projectile travel time, despite the animation.
Shots explode in a 4 meter radius after reaching maximum punch through distance.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Can benefit from  Cautious Shot.
Vaporizes enemies on kill, making it good for stealth when silenced.
Alternate Fire throws the Ferrox, creating a field where it lands that deals  Electricity damage every 2 seconds and continuously pulls enemies within 10 meters toward itself. The field lasts for 30 seconds.
Throwing the spear consumes no ammo. Afterwards, a reload cycle must complete before it can fire or be thrown again. Any existing terrain-embedded spears are removed. Those embedded in a unit's body are not.
The spear is an arcing projectile that can land and embed in the terrain or a unit.
Multishot has no effect on the number of spears thrown.
The field has a flat, unmoddable 50% status chance. It cannot deal critical hits nor headshots and is not affected by multishot. The damage frequency is affected by fire rate. It does not snapshot anything.
Reloads 33% of the magazine per second while deployed or holstered.
Adversary Weapon:
Comes with an additional bonus  Impact,  Heat,  Cold,  Electricity,  Toxin,  Magnetic, or  Radiation damage, which increases the listed base damage of the weapon by 25%-60%.
Valence Fusion can optionally change the resulting output damage type, and can upgrade the bonus increase (up to 60%).
Polarizing the weapon increases its max rank by 2, capping at rank 40 after 5 polarizations, granting the weapon additional mod capacity.
 Elemental Vice can be applied to the weapon after it has reached rank 40, allowing the bonus damage type to be swapped freely.
Unlike Tenet weapons directly acquired from Sisters, the listed Mastery Rank requirement is enforced.

Acquisition

Tenet Ferrox is purchased from Ergo Glast of  The Perrin Sequence in any Relay for 40  Corrupted Holokey obtained from Empyrean Void Storm missions (regardless of standing with The Perrin Sequence syndicate). Each offering has a random progenitor bonus damage type and percentage increase, which is cycled every 4 days.

Notes

Adversary Notes
For weapons obtained from vanquishing the Kuva Lich or Sister:
The player does not have to meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon. It can simply be claimed from the foundry after the Lich/Sister carrying it has been vanquished.
The weapon will have a prefix of the name of the Lich/Sister it was acquired from (e.g. a Kuva Kohm might be called "Odizrigg Agekk Kuva Kohm").
Refraining from Mercy killing an Adversary candidate and letting them die will remove their weapon from the pool of potential Adversary weapons until each has been refused, but only if the mission is completed. Weapons rejected from aborted missions will remain in the current cycle.
It is also possible for the weapon to be removed from the cycle even without waiting for the Adversary candidate to die before extracting from the mission.
For weapons obtained from Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shop:
The player must meet the Mastery Rank displayed to obtain this weapon, as it is claimed from an NPC shop rather than the foundry.
The weapon's max rank caps at 40 after 5 polarizations (max rank increases by 2 per Forma added).
Additional polarizations can be added when the weapon reaches its new max rank at that polarization level.
Each additional rank also gives 100 Mastery Rank experience, giving 4,000 points in total at level 40.
Mod capacity scales with the additional ranks, and can reach a total of 80 at rank 40 with an Orokin Catalyst installed.
Without an Orokin Catalyst, the max is 40. Combined with the five polarized mod slots required to reach that point, an Orokin Catalyst might not be required for some beginner-friendly builds as they typically use less mod capacity.
After polarizing a weapon, any additional mod capacity above 30 (60 with an Orokin Catalyst) will not take effect until the weapon's rank reaches 31 and above.
Legendary Mastery Rank increases the minimum mod capacity for such weapons, without the weapon needing to be rank 31 and above. For example, Legendary 1 increases the minimum capacity to 31 (62 with an Orokin Catalyst).
Comes with an additional damage stat.
For Lich/Sister-obtained weapons this is dependent on the Warframe that summoned the Lich/Sister.
For Ergo Glast's and Eleanor's shops a random bonus stat will be offered for each weapon and changed every 4 days (96 hours).
This damage stat randomly ranges between 25%-60%. It can be upgraded up to its maximum value with Valence Fusion using another copy of the weapon.
The element of this bonus can be changed at will among the available Valence elements once an Elemental Vice is applied.
This bonus stat is considered a base damage type and will be applied after all elemental mods for the purposes of elemental combinations. It uses the weapon's falloff range but always scales linearly from 100% to 0%, regardless of what the weapon's falloff damage scaling is.

*Note that the Primed or Umbra version of a Warframe share the same element

Tips
The weapon's throw attack is especially excellent at fighting off waves of  Corpus enemies, as its pulling field can also reliably apply a shield-debilitating  Electricity (or  Magnetic, if modded with  Primed Cryo Rounds) proc per DoT tick.
Its good automatic fire rate still makes the speargun good at crowd control. Its mass obliteration ability is particularly notable when given a fire rate boost with either  Speed Trigger or Warframe abilities such as  Wisp's Haste Mote from her  Reservoirs.
 Styanax's passive - boosted weapon Critical Chance scaled by his shields and overshields - is doubled for Spearguns such as Tenet Ferrox.

Trivia
The Tenet Ferrox is the first Tenet ranged weapon obtainable via purchase from Ergo Glast, as all other available Tenet weapons from the Perrin Sequence have up to this point been melee weapons.
The Tenet Ferrox is the first charge trigger weapon that has a fully automatic firing function.

Bugs
Tether mode will not count as weapon damage for Citrine's  Prismatic Gem.
Tethers are linked from the base of the shaft, resulting in significantly weaker pull than the base Ferrox due to more of the pull force being downward, when thrown on the ground.
For enemies with both Shield and Armor, or with Overguard, the Attraction Field is completely disabled, including damage and traction effects.
